## Highlights

- New: the seed-track search results (when generating "From Seed") now offer the same short audio preview already available in the playlist view, so you can double-check a candidate track before using it as your reference.

## New and improved

- Hover or focus a search result to reveal its "Preview" button; playback stops automatically when you search again or pick a track.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
